svg.aria-label: Two ways to give 16 positions a window of 4. Each grid row is a working card and each column an earlier position; green squares are the matches the window keeps. As a mask, the machine still works out all 256 squares of the 16 by 16 grid and then throws most away. In chunks of 4, it only ever builds each chunk's 4 rows against its own 4 positions and the 4 before: 112 squares here, and the saving grows with the row, because the chunks grow only in step with it.
svg.text: 16 positions, each looking back at most 4. Every square is one match the machine works out and holds in memory
every square worked out, most thrown away
only each chunk and the one before are built
Double the row and the mask's grid grows four times; the chunks only grow twice. At 4,096 positions: 35.5 GB against 15.1 GB.
